zh.title: 華航9月1日起調漲台灣出口貨運燃油附加費長程每公斤58元
zh.summary: 中華航空9月1日起調漲台灣出口貨物燃油附加費；長程線調至每公斤58元
body: 中華航空向貨運代理商發布通知，為反映國際油價波動，將自2026年9月1日凌晨零時起，調漲台灣地區出口貨物的燃油附加費。本次調整中，歐美等長程航線燃油附加費調升至每公斤新台幣58元，調漲7元，漲幅約13.7%；亞洲短程航線則調升至每公斤20元，調漲2元，漲幅約11.1%。
華航先前在8月中旬已將長程航線貨運燃油附加費調升至51元、短程航線調升至18元。華航說明，除基本運價貨物不予徵收外，其餘台灣出口貨物均按計價重量徵收燃油附加費。

en.title: China Airlines to Raise Cargo Fuel Surcharge from September 1
en.summary: China Airlines will raise export cargo fuel surcharges from September 1 due to rising oil prices.
body: China Airlines has notified freight forwarders that it will adjust fuel surcharges for export cargo originating from Taiwan starting September 1, 2026, to reflect international oil price fluctuations. Under the updated fee structure, the fuel surcharge for long-haul routes to Europe and the Americas will increase by NT$7 to NT$58 per kilogram, representing a rise of approximately 13.7 percent. Meanwhile, the rate for short-haul routes in Asia will increase by NT$2 to NT$20 per kilogram, an advance of about 11.1 percent.

The adjustment follows a previous increase in mid-August, when China Airlines raised long-haul cargo fuel surcharges to NT$51 and short-haul surcharges to NT$18. The carrier stated that except for shipments subject to basic freight rates, all remaining export cargo will be levied the updated fuel surcharge based on chargeable weight.

zh.title: 立院協商無人機條例草案朝野無共識全案保留
zh.summary: 立法院協商無人機條例草案；朝野對主管機關與預算未達共識全案保留
body: 立法院經濟、外交及國防、財政委員會於2026年8月20日舉行朝野黨團協商，研商行政院、國民黨團、民眾黨團及朝野立委所提出的14個版本無人載具條例草案。由於各黨團代表在會議中無法達成共識，會議主席、民眾黨召委洪毓祥最終宣告全案保留，將依相關規定交付後續處理。
本次進行協商的無人載具特別條例草案，先前已於7月27日由立法院三個委員會舉行聯席會議進行審查。當時朝野立委經過長時間討論後，對於法案名稱、主管機關、經費上限以及施行期間等核心條文均未達成共識，最終初審通過並交付黨團協商。
在20日的協商過程當中，朝野各黨團對於條文關鍵內容仍各有堅持。民進黨立法院黨團幹事長莊瑞雄指出，光是法案名稱應訂為特別條例或發展條例，以及主管機關應由何者擔任等問題即存在歧見。民眾黨黨團與國民黨黨團則表示支持國防自主與無人機發展，但強調應注意財政紀律與分批採購機制，並建請立法院長韓國瑜後續召開協商。
列席會議的國防部長顧立雄於會中說明，針對國民黨團版本擬設定每年度預算編列上限新台幣400億元、6年總計2400億元之提議，若特別條例獲通過，光是國防部規劃於115年度與116年度編列的無人機採購項目金額即高達559億元，國民黨版框列的金額將無法有效形成所需的無人機戰力。
顧立雄進一步補充指出，國防部在無人機採購策略上採用「一年一採購」方式，而非一次性採購6年的總數量。此項安排結合相關回饋機制與精進要求，使每年的採購規格能夠比前一年更高，以符合無人機產業與技術快速迭代創新的發展趨勢。

en.title: Taiwan Lawmakers Fail to Reach Consensus on Draft Drone Legislation
en.summary: Taiwan lawmakers retained the draft drone statute after failing to reach cross-party consensus on budget and management.
body: Committees of Taiwan's Legislative Yuan held cross-party negotiations on August 20, 2026, to discuss 14 draft versions of a drone regulation statute submitted by the Executive Yuan, political caucuses, and individual lawmakers. Following extended discussions without consensus among party representatives, meeting chairman and Taiwan People's Party convener Hung Yu-hsiang declared the entire bill retained for subsequent procedural handling.

The joint negotiation follows a prior review on July 27, when the Legislative Yuan's Economics, Foreign Affairs and National Defense, and Finance committees conducted a joint examination of the 14 draft versions. During that initial committee review, lawmakers failed to reach an agreement on core statutory elements, including the official title of the law, the designated competent governing authority, spending limits, and the effective implementation timeframe.

During the August 20 meeting, representatives from major political caucuses expressed differing positions regarding key provisions. Democratic Progressive Party caucus officials noted foundational disagreements over whether to framework the legislation as a special statute or a development act, as well as which agency should serve as the main governing body. Meanwhile, Opposition parties called for adherence to fiscal discipline and phased procurement while supporting domestic defense development.

Addressing the meeting, Defense Minister Ku Li-hsiung commented on the Kuomintang caucus proposal that suggested capping annual budget allocations at NT$40 billion, totaling NT$240 billion over six years. Minister Ku stated that the proposed ceiling would be insufficient, noting that the Ministry of National Defense's planned drone procurement items for fiscal years 2026 and 2027 alone reach NT$55.9 billion.

Minister Ku further explained that the Ministry of National Defense adopts a year-by-year procurement model rather than purchasing the entire six-year volume at once. He emphasized that this annual procurement strategy incorporates feedback mechanisms and performance refinement requirements, ensuring that equipment specifications are continuously upgraded to keep pace with rapid technological iteration in uncrewed aerial systems.

zh.title: 亞馬遜計畫擴大無人機送貨服務 至美國約500個地點
zh.summary: 亞馬遜計畫將無人機送貨服務擴展至美國近500個地點；今年目標為完成100萬次配送。
body: 亞馬遜公司計畫擴充旗下的無人機送貨服務，預計將營運涵蓋範圍拓展至美國約500個地點。此項擴展方案旨在大幅增加無人機空中配送服務的涵蓋區域與服務點。
根據公開報導資料，亞馬遜在推動將無人機服務擴大至近500個城市的計畫前，已於今年設定達成100萬次無人機包裹配送的營運目標。
這項配送網絡擴張行動反映出亞馬遜持續推動自動化無人機物流系統的布局，並致力於提升商業空中配送服務的規模與服務量能。

en.title: Amazon Plans Drone Delivery Service Expansion to Nearly 500 US Locales
en.summary: Amazon plans drone delivery expansion to nearly 500 US locales after targeting 1 million deliveries this year.
body: Amazon plans to expand its aerial drone delivery service to approximately 500 locales across the United States. The planned expansion aims to broaden the company's uncrewed aerial transport footprint and scale up automated delivery capabilities in domestic markets.

The expansion effort follows the company targeting 1 million drone deliveries within this year. Amazon is seeking to scale its drone delivery operations to reach more cities and locations as part of its ongoing aerial logistics initiative.

The planned rollout across nearly 500 cities and locales represents a significant operational expansion for Amazon's uncrewed aerial delivery fleet as it works toward achieving its annual delivery volume goals.

zh.title: 美國航空窄體機隊升級 2028年起重引座椅螢幕並擴增頭等艙
zh.summary: 美國航空將升級窄體機隊，2028年起引進個人座椅螢幕並提升高階座椅比例。
body: 美國航空（American Airlines）宣佈將針對其窄體客機機隊進行大規模客艙升級計畫，自2028年起接收的所有空中巴士（Airbus）與波音（Boeing）客機，將全面配備機上個人座椅螢幕、USB-C快速充電埠以及藍芽音訊連接功能。同時，該航空公司計劃在未來數年內，將窄體機隊中的高階優質座椅比例，由目前的約25%大幅提升至40%。
在具體機型改造方面，美國航空正針對旗下空中巴士A319（ICAO機型代碼A319）與空中巴士A320（ICAO機型代碼A320）機隊進行改裝，以額外增設一排頭等艙座位。此外，該航空公司預計接收的新波音737 MAX 10客機將配備24個頭等艙座位，而其空中巴士A321neo機隊也將重新配置客艙以提供更多頭等艙座位。
除了頭等艙區域的調整外，升級計畫還包含於大多數窄體客機中擴增「超級主客艙」（Main Cabin Extra）座位數量，提供旅客額外腿部空間、優先登機權利、專屬頭頂行李架空間及免費飲料服務。同時，美國航空也將同步改進客艙內部設計，包含採用重新設計的座椅、強化照明系統以及提供更大的行李儲存空間。
此項策略轉變標誌著美國航空客艙配備的重大調整。大約十年前，該航空公司為了降低飛機重量並減少燃料支出，採取了成本削減措施，從旗下波音737與空中巴士A320客機上拆除機上個人螢幕，轉而鼓勵乘客使用個人行動裝置觀賞娛樂內容。隨著高端航空旅遊市場需求增長，航空公司決定重新導入椅背螢幕與升級客艙服務。

en.title: American Airlines to Reintroduce Seatback Screens and Expand Premium Seating on Narrowbody Fleet
en.summary: American Airlines plans to reintroduce seatback screens and expand premium seating across its narrowbody fleet from 2028.
body: American Airlines has announced a comprehensive cabin upgrade program for its narrowbody fleet, under which all new Airbus and Boeing aircraft delivered starting in 2028 will feature personal seatback entertainment screens, USB-C fast-charging ports, and Bluetooth audio connectivity. As part of this broader cabin strategy, the carrier plans to increase the proportion of premium seating across its narrowbody fleet from approximately 25% today to 40% in the coming years.

Regarding specific aircraft modifications, American Airlines is retrofitting its Airbus A319 (ICAO type code A319) and Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320) fleets to add an additional row of First Class seating. Furthermore, upcoming deliveries of the carrier's Boeing 737 MAX 10 aircraft will be configured with 24 First Class seats, while its Airbus A321neo fleet will also be reconfigured to feature extra First Class options.

Beyond first class enhancements, the fleet upgrade plan includes expanding the number of Main Cabin Extra seats across the majority of American's narrowbody aircraft. This upgraded economy option offers passengers additional legroom, earlier boarding privileges, dedicated overhead bin space, and complimentary beverages. The airline will also perform interior cabin refurbishments across its narrowbody aircraft, incorporating redesigned seating, enhanced cabin lighting, and expanded storage space.

This strategic pivot marks a notable shift for the carrier, which approximately a decade ago removed seatback screens from its Boeing 737 and Airbus A320 aircraft as a cost-cutting measure designed to reduce overall aircraft weight and fuel expenses. At the time, passengers were expected to rely on personal electronic devices for inflight entertainment. However, driven by evolving passenger preferences and growing demand in the premium travel market, the airline is now reinstating seatback screens alongside enhanced cabin offerings across its narrowbody fleet.

zh.title: 信實集團與勞斯萊斯合作推動印度AMCA戰機發動機方案
zh.summary: 信實集團與勞斯萊斯合作爭取印度AMCA發動機案；賽峰方案亦正待內閣批准
body: 印度企業信實集團（Reliance Industries）與英國發動機製造商勞斯萊斯（Rolls-Royce）宣佈合作意向，將共同爭取為印度「先進中型戰鬥機」（AMCA）隱形戰鬥機計畫研發自主本土航空發動機。兩家公司規劃在印度建立航空燃氣輪機複合設施，涵蓋發動機設計、測試、生產及全生命週期後勤支援。
根據勞斯萊斯先前提交的提案，該方案包含完整的技術轉移與印度本土智慧財產權所有權。若雙方能在2026年底前簽署正式合約，預計計畫時程將於2030年進行發動機核心機測試，2034年完成首飛，並於2036年正式展開量產作業。信實集團的加入，為勞斯萊斯的技術方案提供了強大的在地工業夥伴支持。
在此項合作提出之際，印度政府同時也在審查另一項競爭方案。由法國賽峰集團（Safran）與印度國防研究與發展組織（DRDO）旗下燃氣輪機研究成立機構（GTRE）合作推進的高推力戰鬥機發動機計畫，目前正等待印度內閣安全委員會（Cabinet Committee on Security）的最終批准。
賽峰集團與國防研究與發展組織先前已達成協議，計畫合作研發一款推力等級達120至140千牛頓（kN）的全新設計發動機，而非早期討論的M88衍生型號。該協議亦涵蓋核心熱段與渦輪架構等關鍵技術的完整轉移，旨在協助印度建立具備自主控制能力的軍用航空動力供應體系。

en.title: Reliance and Rolls-Royce Partner to Propose Engine for India AMCA Fighter
en.summary: Reliance and Rolls-Royce proposed joint engine development for India's AMCA stealth fighter program.
body: Indian conglomerate Reliance Industries and British engine manufacturer Rolls-Royce have announced a strategic partnership to pursue the development of an indigenous engine for India's Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) stealth fighter. The two companies intend to collaborate on the design, development, manufacturing, and delivery of a sovereign combat engine. Additionally, they plan to explore establishing an Aerospace Gas Turbine Complex in India, covering operations from design and testing to full-scale production and through-life support.

Rolls-Royce had submitted its final engine proposal for the AMCA program earlier this year, featuring a complete transfer of technology and Indian ownership of the intellectual property. Under the proposed timeline, if a contract is finalized by the end of 2026, engine-core testing would commence in 2030, followed by a maiden flight in 2034 and initial production starting in 2036. The partnership with Reliance Industries provides the proposal with a major Indian industrial partner to drive domestic manufacturing execution.

The joint proposal enters the field while a competing proposal from France's Safran and the Gas Turbine Research Establishment (GTRE), an entity under India's Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO), moves through government channels. The Safran-DRDO proposal for a high-thrust fighter engine is currently being processed by the Indian government and awaits final authorization from the Cabinet Committee on Security.

Safran previously agreed with DRDO to jointly develop a clean-sheet engine in the 120-140kN thrust class rather than an India-specific derivative of its M88 engine. That agreement includes full technology transfer, granting access to critical hot section technology and turbine architecture to ensure sovereign operational autonomy for India's defense aviation infrastructure.

facts.sourceQuote: A separate proposal from France’s Safran and the Defence Research and Development Organisation’s Gas Turbine Research Establishment (GTRE) for a high-thrust fighter engine is already being processed by the government and awaits final Cabinet Committee on Security approval.

facts.claim: Safran and DRDO had previously agreed to jointly develop a clean-sheet engine in the 120-140kN thrust class with full technology transfer.
facts.sourceQuote: Safran agreed to work with DRDO on a clean-sheet engine rather than the India-specific derivative of its M88 that had previously been discussed.
